name: io.github.SuperAngryMonkey/iris
description: Microsoft 365 mail MCP that drafts into Outlook; sending is off by default and opt-in via IRIS_ENABLE_SEND.

environmentVariables.name: IRIS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Application (client) ID of YOUR OWN Entra app registration. There is no shared app; you register one.

environmentVariables.name: IRIS_DRAFT_FOLDER
environmentVariables.description: Mail folder drafts are written to, created on first use. Defaults to 'AI Drafts'. Empty string uses Drafts.

environmentVariables.name: IRIS_ALLOWLIST
environmentVariables.description: Path to a recipient allowlist file. If absent or empty, all recipients are permitted.

environmentVariables.name: IRIS_ENABLE_SEND
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to enable sending. ALSO requires Mail.Send granted on the Entra app and a fresh sign-in. Off by default; when unset, iris cannot send and the send tool is not registered.
